mapper.select: select promotion_id, merchant_id, promotion_title, start_time, end_time from merchant_login_promotion where merchant_id=#{merchantId} order by promotion_id desc limit #{start},#{need}

select promotion_id, merchant_id, promotion_title, start_time, end_time from merchant_login_promotion where merchant_id=#{merchantId} and start_time <= now() and end_time >= now() order by promotion_id desc limit #{start},#{need}

select promotion_id, merchant_id, voucher_id, promotion_title, promotion_description, promotion_notice, participant_amount, start_time, end_time, create_time from merchant_login_promotion where promotion_id=#{promotionId}
mapper.update: update merchant_login_promotion set participant_amount=participant_amount+1 where promotion_id=#{promotionId} and start_time <= now() and end_time >= now()
